records.text: Ongoing indefinite survival: Morgan Vale, ordinary custom Evacuee/Survivor, in newly created default-rules world Baytown. In-play character screen established identity. At evac shelter A-23, spring day 61, about 8:06 AM. Full green health, fresh, no pain/thirst/hunger visible. Wields crafted wooden club. Inventory shows pocket knife, matchbook 20 matches, smartphone 54/56 battery (flashlight off), sealed bottle with 2 clean water, and 3 small cardboard boxes containing protein rations carried in messenger bag. After smashing one cupboard, pickup showed 21 boxes of protein ration plus one cold box; selected and actually picked up 3 of the 21, leaving approximately 18 plus cold box on floor one tile west of current character; other cupboard stock not yet surveyed. Erin Bergman is at shelter; persuasion to follow failed, accepted task to retrieve a US flag. Initial faction succession mission failed upon spawn. Basement was briefly explored, no supplies seen in north/west corridors. A window in north wall is open and usable as exit. Map showed forest and murky water west, town Columbia south. Plan: use shelter as temporary base, conserve water and food, find safe renewable water and cooking container, cautiously scout for tools/food while avoiding fights. No debug used. An unrelated random-start character was accidentally created in prior world LaPorte and saved to menu before creating Baytown; do not load it. Current Morgan has not yet been saved.

next_steps: find safe water and cooking vessel

labels.note: The work record's world is Baytown; the final report says the load list shows the survivor in Cedar Butte.
